checks.message: RC21-011 must run after RC21-010 completed, with current_task set to RC21-011 or during an idempotent rerun.
RC21-011 must consume the RC21 journal and snapshot baseline contract.
RC21-011 must bind the completed RC21-010 local operation intent catalog.
Snapshot baseline must bind RC20 target, updated, and restored states from lifecycle support/recovery evidence.
Every operation intent must bind deterministic transaction id, audit sink, resume checkpoint, and rollback snapshot reference.
Transaction ids must be deterministic and unique across the six lifecycle operation intents.
Snapshot baseline package must be projection-only and bind RC20 target, updated, and restored states without host or active artifact mutation.
RC21-011 must write only local journal/snapshot packages and must not execute lifecycle effects or broaden forbidden authority.
Baseline denial cases must cover missing, stale, mismatched, broad, remote, support, recovery, signer, object storage, host, production, and GA attempts.
RC21-011 outputs must not contain private key blocks, private authority paths, auth tokens, signing key file names, raw passwords, or raw secrets.

fail_closed_cases.reason: Transaction journal baseline requires RC21-010 operation intent catalog.
Snapshot baseline requires RC20 lifecycle support/recovery result.
Snapshot baseline denies mismatched target state.
Update and downgrade journal entries require updated state evidence.
Rollback snapshot references require restored target state evidence.
Every transaction entry requires a local audit sink.
Every transaction entry requires a resume checkpoint.
Every transaction entry requires rollback snapshot reference.
Active artifact set mutation is forbidden.
Support upload is outside RC21 body scope.
Recovery execution is outside RC21 body scope.
Remote dispatch is outside RC21 body scope.
Signer authority is outside RC21 body scope.
Object storage provisioning is outside RC21 body scope.
Journal and snapshot baseline cannot claim GA production readiness.
